title: Digital Experience Solution Architect
description:
Join Toptal’s Elite Network of Freelance Talent

Toptal is an exclusive network of the world’s top freelance software developers, designers, finance experts, product managers, and project managers. As one of the fastest-growing fully remote networks globally, we empower professionals to thrive in their freelance careers while working with leading companies around the world.


About the Client

Our client is a global consumer goods leader dedicated to developing essential products, with a strong focus on innovation, sustainability, and responsible manufacturing.


Role: Digital Experience Solution Architect

Seeking an experienced Digital Experience Architect to lead the design and implementation of secure, scalable, and high-performing brand websites. This role drives technical strategy, personalization, and compliance across digital platforms while mentoring teams and fostering innovation.


About the Role

This is a high-impact role within a global consumer goods company, focused on modernizing digital brand experiences through MACH architecture and cloud-native solutions. The digital team is transitioning legacy platforms to composable, API-first environments to improve speed, performance, and personalization. Collaboration across marketing, legal, compliance, and engineering functions is essential to align technical architecture with business goals and regulatory standards. The team prioritizes innovation, sustainability, and inclusivity, with strong support for career development and hybrid work flexibility.


Task and Deliverables

  • Architect and implement scalable, secure digital solutions for global brand websites
  • Lead the transition to modern CMS systems using MACH principles (Microservices, API-first, Cloud-native, Headless)
  • Integrate personalization tools and performance optimization techniques to drive measurable business outcomes
  • Ensure compliance with global privacy regulations (CPRA/CCPA, GDPR) and lead consent and data protection architecture
  • Maintain architectural documentation including roadmaps, runbooks, and system diagrams.
  • Provide full-stack technical leadership across frontend (React) and backend systems
  • Guide teams on technology selection, architecture best practices, and compliance integration
  • Ensure uptime and reliability through proactive monitoring, incident response, and root cause analysis
  • Mentor team members, fostering a culture of technical excellence
  • Support legacy systems during phased migration to modern architecture


Requirements


Must Have:

  • 8+ years of experience in solution architecture for large-scale, consumer-facing digital platforms
  • Expertise in full-stack development (React frontend, CMS/backend, API-first integration)
  • Strong knowledge of MACH architecture and modern CMS platforms (headless and traditional)
  • Experience with Azure or AWS and cloud-native deployments
  • Strong understanding of relational databases, SQL, and web security best practices
  • Familiarity with containerization, composable architectures, and event-driven design


Nice to Have:

  • Experience with Customer Data Platforms (CDPs) and real-time personalization
  • Knowledge of identity resolution and event-based customer interaction flows
  • Exposure to eCommerce platforms and digital marketing technologies


Additional Details

  • Location: Remote in Brazil or Argentina
  • Type: 40h/week Contract
  • Duration: 6–12 months (with possibility of extension)
  • Authorization: Applicants must be authorized to work in their country of residence without employer sponsorship

title: Senior Full-Stack Engineer (Remote – Brazil)
description:
About the job


Company: Hitch

Location: Remote (5+ hours overlap with San Francisco PST required. South America preferred.)

Position: Full-Time


About HitchHitch is a fast-growing fintech building the digital rails for home equity lending. We power lenders like Deephaven and MyEQNow, helping them originate and scale HELOCs, Home Equity Investments, and other non-QM products. Backed by top VCs and featured in HousingWire, we’re transforming how borrowers access their home equity.


The Role

We’re looking for a Senior Full-Stack Engineer who wants ownership, impact, and visibility. You’ll join a small but elite remote team (Brazil, Portugal, US) and play a critical role in designing, building, and scaling the next generation of our lending platform.


  • What You’ll DoLead development of high-quality, scalable web apps using TypeScript + Next.js
  • Drive architectural decisions and shape technical direction
  • Collaborate closely with product and design to ship meaningful features fast
  • Mentor junior/intermediate engineers and raise the bar on code quality
  • Build integrations with cloud infrastructure, credit, income, and valuation vendors
  • Optimize performance, scalability, and security across the stack


  • What We’re Looking For5+ years building and scaling web applications
  • Expert in TypeScript, Next.js, and React
  • Strong experience with MongoDB, Redis, Docker
  • Familiarity with AWS, GCP, or other cloud providers
  • Strong communicator, thrives in a remote and autonomous environment
  • Bonus: Zod, tRPC, Prisma, Jest/Playwright, BullMQ, fintech/lending background


  • Why HitchImpact from Day 1: Your code will be in the hands of thousands of brokers and borrowers immediately
  • High-Growth Startup: Join a company that is powering some of the largest lenders in Non-QM (loans for entrepreneurs) mortgage space
  • Elite Team: Work with sharp, collaborative engineers across Brazil, and the US
  • Remote-Friendly: Flexible work, with focus on ownership not hours


How to Apply

Apply here:


  • Tell us why you want to join Hitch and how your skills align with our stack.

title: Financial Institutions Partnership Director
description:
Job Description

●Build up strategic partnership with major financial institutions in the respective regions/business line, nurturing business collaboration with global banks and other financial institutions to enhance the company services on providing payment, collection and other services that is related to B2B verticals and merchants growth.

●Develop and execute channel partnership strategy through identifying the potential partners, negotiating, closing partnership deals, implementing, and managing complex partnership engagements.

●Ensure project deliverable in terms of channel integration and optimisation are executed with quality and timely.

●Review process gaps, identify areas for improvement and drive the payment optimisation. ●Manage partnerships to review success factors and hold periodic meetings to discuss sales & marketing strategies, lead-gen, and new products/features.

●Research on the business model and compliance policy of oversea funds management practice in local market.



The Successful Applicant:

●Min 5 years of working experience in collaboration with local financial institution or payment channel industry.

●In-depth understanding on local regulation and compliance regarding payment business and cross border fund movement.

●Experience in negotiation and partnership proposal development

●Ability to maintain high efficiency across different countries

●Solid interpersonal skills, logical thinking and analytical skills

●Highly organised and able to manage multiple priorities, enjoys working in a fast-paced and dynamic environment

title: Analista de BI
description:
Código da vaga: 57581


Há 32 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Com uma plataforma de serviços end to end, oferecemos as mais eficientes e inovadoras soluções, tecnologias e metodologias, promovendo uma jornada de transformação para grandes marcas, de diferentes segmentos, no Brasil e no exterior.

Nossos 2.500 mil funcionários atuam no modelo de trabalho Anywhere Office e a empresa é destaque como um dos melhores lugares para trabalhar pelo GPTW e Glassdoor.


Ei #fera , chegou o momento de encarar um novo desafio em sua carreira! Venha ser um #ferabrq !


No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia! É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.


Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente.


O que procuramos?


Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!



O que você deve ter?


- Experiência anterior em projetos de Governança de Dados ou BI;

- Capacidade de mapeamento de processos e documentação (BPMN);

- Forte visão analítica e habilidade para traduzir requisitos de negócio em estruturas de dados;

- Conhecimento em gestão de metadados, glossário, linhagem e políticas de dados;

- Experiência com ferramentas de catálogo de dados (desejável: OpenMetadata);

- Conhecimento prático em SQL e Python;

- Familiaridade com ambientes AWS (S3, Glue, Redshift, IAM);

- Noções de ETL/ELT e ferramentas como dbt, Airflow ou similares;

- Conhecimento em LGPD e boas práticas de segurança da informação;


O que será um diferencial?


- Familiaridade com DAMA DMBOK;

- Conhecimento em DataOps e automação de pipelines de dados;

- Certificações ou cursos em Governança de Dados, LGPD ou AWS;

- Experiência com metodologias ágeis (Scrum / Kanban);


O que temos pra te oferecer?


A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 pilares:


Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!


Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.


Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.


Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.


As oportunidades são CLT com muitos benefícios, olha só:


Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Home Office; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!


Como é trabalhar na BRQ?


Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.com/brqdigitalsolutions .


Curtiu? Então inscreva-se e venha para o melhor da Transformação Digital com a gente!

title: Executive Search Consultant
description:
About Gold & Aron:

Gold & Aron Conseil is a boutique executive search firm with a 20+ year track record of placing top-tier talent in the Technology and Financial Services industries across the Americas and Europe.


About the Role

We are hiring an Executive Search Senior Associate to support Gold & Aron CEO and COO across high-impact searches in Technology and Financial Services in a premium boutique environment. The role blends deep research, pipeline development, and end-to-end recruiting for select mid-level roles. You’ll help build the engine that enables leadership to focus on client strategy and firm growth.


WHAT YOU WILL DO


Candidate Research & Sourcing for senior level searches (60%)

  • Build and manage strong candidate pipelines across multiple concurrent searches.
  • Active search: Conduct structured research, market mapping using several tech tools including Linkedin, AI tools and own data base.
  • Passive search: Source, screen applicants
  • Lead candidate scoring, initial candidate assessment


End to end Recruiting for selected mid level searches (30%)

  • Build and manage candidate pipeline
  • Conduct first-round screens to assess fit and motivation.
  • Prepare concise candidate summaries and search updates.
  • Support client communications and progress check-ins.
  • Coordinate interviews and every other step of the hiring process.


Business Development Support (10%)

  • Research companies, markets, and potential clients
  • Build prospect lists and market intelligence for the CEO and COO.
  • Bring new ideas, new BD initiatives for the company


IDEAL CANDIDATE PROFILE

  • 3–7+ years in research, consulting, finance, tech, recruiting, or similar fields.
  • Experience in or recruiting for Tech or Financial Services is a strong plus.
  • Advanced English + Native Portuguese is a must. Spanish is a strong plus.
  • Analytical, structured thinker with strong organization and attention to detail.
  • Comfortable with ambiguity; bias for action; strong ownership mindset.
  • Bachelor’s degree mandatory.
  • Location: Brazil remote. Preference for São Paulo, SP.

  • Provide frontline support via phone and ticketing systems to resolve software-related issues.
  • Gather key details to assess and triage cases to the appropriate internal teams.

  • Ensure timely responses and resolutions in line with defined SLAs.
  • Collaborate with internal teams, vendors, and partners to drive case resolution.

title: Controls Engineer
description:
Build the Future of Automation as a Robotics Controls Engineer


We’re looking for a Robotics Controls Engineer who’s ready to take the lead in designing, programming, and optimizing cutting-edge robotic automation systems. In this hands-on role, you’ll bring bespoke robotic solutions to life, developing advanced control algorithms, integrating real-time systems, and delivering precision, performance, and reliability across industrial robot applications.


You’ll work side by side with mechanical, electrical, and production teams to create fully integrated automation solutions from concept to commissioning. From running simulations and performance testing to solving complex control challenges, your expertise will directly shape innovative, high-impact systems used in real-world environments.


This is an exciting opportunity for a controls engineer with 3+ years of industrial robot programming experience, a deep passion for automation, and the drive to push the boundaries of what robotic systems can achieve. If you’re eager to make a tangible impact on next-generation robotics, and see your work in action, this role is for you.


Key Responsibilities


  • Develop, implement, and optimise control algorithms for bespoke robotic systems.
  • Design and integrate control systems for real-time operation, ensuring precise and efficient movement, sensing, and interaction.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including mechanical design engineers, control engineers, and the production teams, to ensure seamless integration into our bespoke robotic automation & control systems.
  • Conduct simulations and testing to validate control algorithms, mechanical design, manipulator suitability and optimise performance to meet cycle time commitments.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve control system issues, ensuring smooth operation and reliability.
  • Stay updated with the latest advancements in robotics controls across multiple vendor platforms and identify opportunities for innovation and improvement.
  • Document design processes, specifications, and develop technical reports.


Qualifications:


  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Robotics, Electrical Engineering, or a related field.
  • 3+ years experience with programming industrial robots is essential.
  • Strong background in robotics controls and demonstrated experience in developing control algorithms for robotic systems, experience with programming ABB robots is essential.
  • Familiarity and experience with robotic hardware platforms, PLC programming (Rockwell, Siemens, Omron etc), sensors, and actuators.
  • Solid understanding of control theory, including PID control, state-space control, and adaptive control.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and ability to troubleshoot complex control system issues.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills to work effectively in cross functional teams.
  • Experience with industrial automation, machine vision, or motion planning is desirable.

Qualifications:

  • Strong communication and collaboration skills to work effectively in cross functional teams.

title: Java Software Engineer
description:
Sr. Java Engineer #2477


Position Summary:

Our partner, a leading SaaS provider of unified IT operations solutions designed to simplify and automate the management of IT infrastructure, is adding a Senior Java Engineer to their team. This person should be a strategic thinker and experienced Sr. Java Developer with a strong foundation in multi-tiered projects and a track record of success in growing companies. You will be responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining Java-based systems and applications that integrate with multiple solutions. In this role, you will work closely with cross-functional teams to ensure the security, scalability, and efficiency of critical applications. The ideal candidate should have a deep understanding of cross-functional solutions and their integration with Java-based applications, along with the ability to navigate scalability challenges and contribute to long-term technical strategy.


Experience and Education:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or relevant experience in a related field.
  • 5+ years of software development experience using Java
  • Experience building, debugging, and maintaining enterprise SaaS web applications using Java.
  • Expertise in multi-tiered architecture, backend development, APIs, and cloud-based deployments.
  • Proficiency in designing, implementing, and supporting enterprise-level applications and database design.
  • Knowledge of modern development practices, including CI/CD, automated testing, and DevOps methodologies.
  • Strong problem-solving and strategic thinking skills, with experience in scaling applications within a growing company.


Skills and Strengths:

  • Java
  • Java 8+
  • Spring boot
  • Kotlin
  • Monolithic Architecture
  • Architecture Principles
  • AWS
  • RESTful APIs
  • Web Services: REST, SOAP, XML, JSON
  • GIT Source Control
  • PostgreSQL
  • NoSQL Databases
  • Jmeter
  • Junit
  • ELK Stack
  • Redis
  • OOP
  • Maven
  • Observability & Monitoring Tools
  • Docker/Kubernetes
  • CI/CD
  • Root Cause Analysis and Troubleshooting
  • TDD
  • Unit Testing


Primary Job Responsibilities:

  • Design, develop, and maintain Java-based systems and applications.
  • Write clean, efficient, and well-documented Java code.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define and design new features.
  • Ensure code quality through thorough testing and debugging.
  • Troubleshoot and provide solutions for system-related issues.
  • Stay up to date with new trends and technologies in software development.
  • Maintain system documentation and ensure modifications are thoroughly documented.
  • Participate in code reviews and team meetings to improve quality and project progress.
  • Continuously improve software development processes and methodologies.
  • Create test plans and coordinate testing for enhancements and new versions of Zendesk environments.
  • Lead system requirements gathering sessions to identify critical business needs.

title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
Jr. Full-Stack Engineer (2+ yrs of experience) – 100% Remote | Contract | English Fluency | Brazil Based


We’re partnering with a global digital platform company that operates one of the world’s largest online ecosystems for communities, conversations, and user-generated content. Their mission is to empower people to connect around shared interests and cultural moments, enabling authentic discussion and high-impact digital experiences at massive scale.


They are looking for a Full-Stack Engineer to lead the creation of in-app community experiences inside the social media ecosystem, with a strong focus on high-engagement cultural moments in the UK .


What you’ll be doing

  • Lead the conceptualization, design, and execution of in-app community experiences tailored to high-interest UK cultural moments
  • Build and launch robust, scalable client-side features using the Devvit Developer Platform
  • Translate cultural trends and community needs into high-performance web applications within Reddit, owning the full development lifecycle from idea to deployment
  • Develop a deep understanding of community culture and technical needs to rapidly iterate on content, features, and engagement strategies
  • Collaborate closely with cross-functional partners to turn growth strategies and community feedback into clear technical requirements
  • Analyze application performance and usage data to guide prioritization and iteration


Technical Requirements

  • 2+ years of hands-on experience in full-stack web development
  • Strong proficiency in JavaScript / TypeScript , HTML , and CSS
  • Demonstrable experience with React and modern front-end development
  • Experience building and deploying server-side applications using Node.js (Express, Koa, or similar frameworks)
  • Solid understanding of API integration, data modeling, and client/server architecture
  • Experience managing application state and data using tools such as Redis for caching or storage
  • Familiarity with the Devvit Developer Platform and its SDKs (@devvit/client, @devvit/server) is a strong plus


General Requirements

  • Fluent English , with a strong understanding of UK culture and language nuances
  • Proven ability to manage multiple projects and community launch cycles simultaneously
  • Experience designing and executing community activations or platform-based experiences
  • Strong familiarity with Reddit , its ecosystem, and user expectations
  • Ability to quickly adapt to different content verticals and cultural contexts
  • Availability to dedicate 20–40 hours per week to Reddit growth initiatives


Why this role

  • High ownership from concept to live community impact
  • Flexible remote contract
  • Opportunity to shape large-scale community experiences during high-traffic cultural moments

Jr. Full-Stack Engineer (2+ yrs of experience) – 100% Remote | Contract | English Fluency | Brazil Based


We’re partnering with a global digital platform company that operates one of the world’s largest online ecosystems for communities, conversations, and user-generated content. Their mission is to empower people to connect around shared interests and cultural moments, enabling authentic discussion and high-impact digital experiences at massive scale.


They are looking for a Full-Stack Engineer to lead the creation of in-app community experiences inside the social media ecosystem, with a strong focus on high-engagement cultural moments in the UK .


What you’ll be doing

  • Lead the conceptualization, design, and execution of in-app community experiences tailored to high-interest UK cultural moments
  • Build and launch robust, scalable client-side features using the Devvit Developer Platform
  • Translate cultural trends and community needs into high-performance web applications within Reddit, owning the full development lifecycle from idea to deployment
  • Develop a deep understanding of community culture and technical needs to rapidly iterate on content, features, and engagement strategies
  • Collaborate closely with cross-functional partners to turn growth strategies and community feedback into clear technical requirements
  • Analyze application performance and usage data to guide prioritization and iteration


Technical Requirements

  • 2+ years of hands-on experience in full-stack web development
  • Strong proficiency in JavaScript / TypeScript , HTML , and CSS
  • Demonstrable experience with React and modern front-end development
  • Experience building and deploying server-side applications using Node.js (Express, Koa, or similar frameworks)
  • Solid understanding of API integration, data modeling, and client/server architecture
  • Experience managing application state and data using tools such as Redis for caching or storage
  • Familiarity with the Devvit Developer Platform and its SDKs (@devvit/client, @devvit/server) is a strong plus


General Requirements

  • Fluent English , with a strong understanding of UK culture and language nuances
  • Proven ability to manage multiple projects and community launch cycles simultaneously
  • Experience designing and executing community activations or platform-based experiences
  • Strong familiarity with Reddit , its ecosystem, and user expectations
  • Ability to quickly adapt to different content verticals and cultural contexts
  • Availability to dedicate 20–40 hours per week to Reddit growth initiatives


Why this role

  • High ownership from concept to live community impact
  • Flexible remote contract
  • Opportunity to shape large-scale community experiences during high-traffic cultural moments

title: Pessoa Engenheira de Dados  - Vaga afirmativa para pessoas LGBTQIAPN+
description:
A vaga atual é para o escritório do Brasil e trabalhamos em um modelo Free Office.

Quem somos:

Nós da Artefact LatAm acreditamos e vivemos uma cultura com base na empatia!

Um ambiente de trabalho saudável é um lugar onde todas as vozes são ouvidas, respeitadas e valorizadas.

Temos como nosso compromisso a construção de um ambiente mais diverso e inclusivo, porque a empatia é para todas as pessoas, independentemente de etnia, cor, gênero, orientação sexual, identidade de gênero, deficiência ou crença religiosa.

Queremos conosco mentes e corações incríveis! Venha ser Artefact!

Quais serão suas responsabilidades:

Você se juntará à nossa equipe de Dados e Consultoria, que ajuda os clientes a transformar e melhorar sua estratégia de dados aplicando análises avançadas para gerar insights que criam valor de negócio a partir de big data e inteligência artificial.

  • Inovar . Você trabalhará com sua equipe, composta por consultores, cientistas de dados, e engenheiros, para identificar as necessidades dos clientes e definir soluções inovadoras.
  • Aprender e Compartilhar. Você trabalhará em uma equipe colaborativa que promove o compartilhamento de conhecimento. Você aprenderá com outras pessoas, compartilhará conhecimento e ficará a par das novidades/atualizações do setor.
  • Desenvolver. Você participará da solução do início ao fim. Com o auxílio de engenheiros seniores, você gerenciará a concepção e a implementação, além de otimizar o desempenho e a escalabilidades.
  • Atuar em toda a cadeia de valor dos projetos (criação de infraestruturas e plataformas, coleta de dados, aplicação de modelos de aprendizado de máquina, criações de APIs REST, de front-ends, de testes, implementações contínuas).
  • Popularizar termos técnicos ou soluções para perfis mais orientados a negócios, pode trabalhar em uma equipe com perfis muito diversificados.
  • Priorizar suas tarefas, respeitar prazos e se levantar a mão em caso de riscos ou problemas.

O que estamos procurando:

  • Ter cursado graduação em ciência da computação, estatística, engenharia, economia ou uma área relacionada.
  • Curiosidade: você está sempre buscando soluções inovadoras para seus clientes. Você está envolvido em toda a cadeia de valor, que pode ser front-end, back-end, infraestrutura de big data, modelo de ML...
  • Colaboração: o compartilhamento de conhecimento é essencial para você e você participa ativamente da difusão de informações dentro da Artefact.
  • Empreendedorismo: você traz soluções, novas ideias, inovações

O que oferecemos:

  • VR/VT
  • Free office (trabalhe de casa ou de onde quiser!)
  • Gympass
  • Seguros: Vida, saúde e odontológico
  • Encontros Bimestrais (Famoso “Get Together” onde nos encontramos para estarmos juntos, com oficinas, palestras, treinamentos e aquele happy hour!
  • Woba (pode marcar para trabalhar em coworking onde quiser!)
  • Avaliações semestrais (com oportunidade de promoção)

Por que você deveria se juntar a nós:

  • Artefact é o lugar para estar: venha e construa o futuro da área de dados.
  • Progresso: cada dia oferece novos desafios e novas oportunidades de aprender.
  • Cultura: Empatia e Colaboração está no nosso DNA.
  • Empreendedorismo: você se juntará a uma equipe de empreendedores motivados. Não desistiremos até que façamos uma grande diferença nesta indústria!

Junte-se a nós!

title: Programador Ruby
description:
Descrição da Empresa: OniLearning Technology é uma edtech brasileira cujo objetivo é melhorar a aprendizagem, permitindo que pessoas organizem e criem seu próprio conteúdo educacional. Utilizamos aplicativos móveis que facilitam o processo de aprendizagem, envolvendo professores, alunos e escolas, do ensino fundamental ao ensino superior. Para alunos, OniLearning funciona como um caderno digital inteligente e interativo, enquanto para professores oferece a criação de material didático personalizado. As instituições educacionais economizam custos e aprimoram a qualidade da educação com o uso de OniLearning. Juntem-se a nós nessa revolução educacional!


Descrição do Cargo: Estamos buscando um Programador Ruby para integrar nossa equipe. Este cargo envolve desenvolver, manter e melhorar nossas aplicações Ruby, colaborando com outros desenvolvedores e equipes de produto para entregar soluções de alta qualidade. O profissional será responsável por garantir a performance e a escalabilidade dos sistemas, além de implementar novas funcionalidades e corrigir bugs. Este é um cargo de tempo integral e remoto.


Qualificações:

  • Desenvolvimento em Ruby: Necessário experiência em programação com Ruby e Ruby on Rails, desenvolvimento de aplicativos web e APIs.
  • Design de Software: Habilidades em design de software, práticas de codificação limpa e arquitetura de sistemas.
  • Controle de Versão: Familiaridade com ferramentas de controle de versão, como Git, para gerenciar e compartilhar código.
  • Trabalho em Equipe: Capacidade de colaborar efetivamente com equipes multifuncionais, habilidades de comunicação e resolução de problemas.
  • Serão considerados diferenciais conhecimentos em outras linguagens de programação, experiência em metodologias ágeis e formação na área de Tecnologia da Informação ou afins.


Interessado? Envie seu currículo diretamente ao nosso head: Paulo Afonso C. Arruda, pelo e-mail:



A ONIlearning Technology agradece antecipadamente o seu interesse em fazer parte de nosso time de campeões!


Paulo Afonso Cardoso de Arruda

Head de Operações e Tecnologia

ONIlearning Technology

title: Sr. DevOps Engineer
description:
We are looking for a Sr. DevOps Engineer to work for our client. The ideal candidate aligns with the responsibilities and qualifications outlined below.


About the Role

Our client is seeking a DevOps Engineer to support CI/CD pipelines, improve automation, and ensure the reliability of production systems. You’ll work closely with development and infrastructure teams to streamline deployments, enhance performance, and maintain secure, scalable environments.


Key Responsibilities

  • Manage and improve build/deployment pipelines.
  • Administer Azure DevOps (permissions, branching, policies).
  • Support deployments using tools like Octopus Deploy.
  • Troubleshoot build and deployment issues.
  • Monitor production environments and coordinate upgrades.
  • Implement automation to reduce technical debt and improve CI/CD efficiency.
  • Assist with infrastructure management using Chef, Terraform, or similar tools.
  • Maintain documentation and communicate project status to stakeholders.


Qualifications

  • Microsoft system administration experience.
  • Active Directory, Windows Server, and IIS knowledge.
  • Familiarity with .NET environments and Git.
  • PowerShell scripting skills.
  • Linux administration experience.
  • Experience with Infrastructure as Code (Chef/Terraform).
  • Strong communication and teamwork skills.
  • Experience in agile development environments.


What Our Client Offers

  • 100% remote work in Brazil.
  • Modern DevOps tools and technologies.
  • Collaborative, growth-focused engineering culture.

title: Líder técnico de Java
description:
A Foursys é um time apaixonado por inovação, design e transformação digital. Somos globais, somos GPTW.


Na Foursys, celebramos a diversidade e acreditamos que são as diferentes ideias e perspectivas que nos enriquecem. Portanto, sua cor, religião, gênero, raça, nacionalidade, idade, origem, identidade de gênero, deficiência ou orientação sexual não são barreiras para se juntar à nossa equipe. #VemSerFoursys! Todas as nossas vagas estão abertas para Pessoas com Deficiência (PCD). Caso você se enquadre ou conheça alguém com o perfil, a Foursys é a empresa ideal!


Que tal se juntar a nós e se tornar um(a) #FourTalent? Então se liga nessa oportunidade incrível:

Atuar como Java Tech Lead Especialista, liderando tecnicamente soluções backend em ambiente multicloud.

Responsável por decisões de arquitetura, integração entre clouds e padrões técnicos do time.

Responsabilidades

  • Liderar tecnicamente o time backend em ambientes multicloud
  • Definir e evoluir arquiteturas distribuídas , resilientes e escaláveis
  • Apoiar decisões de integração entre clouds e estratégias de observabilidade
  • Realizar code reviews , definição de padrões e resolução de problemas complexos
  • Garantir qualidade, performance, segurança e governança das aplicações
  • Atuar próximo aos times de produto, arquitetura e negócio
  • Promover práticas de engenharia como BDD/TDD , automação e melhoria contínua
  • Mentorar e desenvolver tecnicamente os profissionais do time

Habilidades Técnicas (Obrigatórias)

  • Java SE 21
  • Arquitetura backend moderna (microserviços, APIs, mensageria)
  • Bancos de dados: SQL Server e BigQuery
  • Testes automatizados: JUnit e Mockito
  • Testes de performance: JMeter
  • Design Patterns e princípios de arquitetura limpa
  • Práticas de desenvolvimento: BDD / TDD

☁️ Cloud & Multicloud

Experiência prática em ambientes multicloud , incluindo:

Google Cloud Platform (GCP):

  • Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE )
  • Pub/Sub
  • Cloud Dataflow

Outros provedores (AWS e/ou Azure):

  • Kubernetes gerenciado (EKS / AKS)
  • Serviços de mensageria e integração
  • Estratégias de deploy, observabilidade e segurança

title: Application Developer (Maintenance - JAVA/MySQL)
description:
We are looking for an Application Developer with strong experience in Java and My to support and enhance our client's application system, on the transportation product line.

The ideal candidate will be highly adept at working in a vibrant, dynamic startup environment with a small team, have proven on-time delivery experience, strong problem-solving abilities as well as aptitude to learn new technologies and concepts quickly, and be trustworthy, team-oriented, and transparent.

Our industry-leading client provides cloud-based business automation software for over 2000 independent upstream and midstream oil & gas companies in North America. The companys solutions manage land, production, accounting, and transportation for E&P operators, crude oil purchasers, transporters, haulers, investors, and accounting firms. Their customers benefit through the automation of the most complex business processes to reduce operating costs, save time, and increase profitability via reporting, analytics, and decision support systems that were once exclusive to the major integrated oil companies.


Responsibilities

  • Portal & Server Management: Troubleshoot portal server ers, monitor AWS logs, and ensure report delivery.
  • ETL & Data Operations: Manage ETL file uploads, monitor ongoing/completed loads, and resolve missing data issues.
  • Reporting (JasperReports): Maintain and enhance custom reports, add/remove columns and filters, manage run tickets, and troubleshoot disappearing reports.
  • Database Management (My): Perform schema updates, optimize queries, and ensure data integrity for reporting and ETL processes.
  • Integrations: Support Samsara, Geotab, and Motive integrations and data imports.
  • Environment Management: Handle migrations between Alpha, Beta, and Production environments.
  • Bulk Updates: Execute mass-scale changes (Tank ID, Lease Name, Account, Terminal details) and perform data cleanup.


Required Experience

  • Excellent verbal and written English communication skills
  • 3+ years of experience using Java and My
  • Solid understanding of AWS logs and backend troubleshooting, preferably using Cloud watch
  • Comfortable working in CI/CD environments with Agile development practices
  • Understanding of ETL & Data Management for file uploads and load monitoring
  • Detail-oriented and highly organized with a proactive mindset
  • Able to work independently and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced environment
  • Trustworthy, team-oriented, and transparent


Preferred Experience

  • Experience with JasperReports
  • Prior experience using React.js


Additional Information

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with smart and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Lets learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • Start: ASAP


About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent that enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued client team members. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
Overview

We’re looking for a senior-level Full-Stack PHP Developer who thrives on solving real problems, takes full ownership of systems, and communicates clearly and thoroughly. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys digging into existing applications, understanding how they actually work, and improving them with pragmatic, well-reasoned solutions.

You’ll work on production SaaS systems built primarily on PHP 8 and CodeIgniter , spanning application logic, data modeling, and frontend integration. We value engineers who think end-to-end, explain their reasoning, and treat the product as if they own it.


What You’ll Do

  • Own application features and fixes from start to finish — from investigation and design through implementation and rollout
  • Deep-dive into existing PHP/CodeIgniter codebases to debug issues, improve reliability, and reduce technical debt
  • Design and implement new features with attention to maintainability, performance, and clarity
  • Collaborate closely with product and engineering peers, clearly explaining tradeoffs, risks, and decisions
  • Improve application architecture incrementally (schemas, services, controllers, APIs)
  • Participate in production issue triage and root-cause analysis when needed
  • Proactively identify improvements rather than waiting for tickets


Core Technical Requirements

  • Strong experience with PHP 8 in production environments
  • Hands-on experience with CodeIgniter (or deep familiarity with similar MVC PHP frameworks)
  • Solid background in LAMP-style stacks (Linux, MySQL/MariaDB, PHP, Apache/Nginx)
  • Experience building and consuming RESTful APIs
  • Comfortable working across backend and frontend boundaries
  • Working knowledge of JavaScript, AJAX, and modern browser behavior
  • Strong SQL skills and experience designing/debugging relational schemas


Nice-to-Have (Not Required)

  • Familiarity with Redis, Elasticsearch, or similar data stores
  • Exposure to CI/CD pipelines, basic DevOps workflows, or cloud hosting (AWS/GCP/etc.)
  • Experience modernizing legacy PHP applications
  • Familiarity with containerized or service-oriented deployments


What We Care About Most

  • Ownership mentality — you don’t just “complete tasks,” you take responsibility for outcomes
  • Problem-solving depth — you like understanding why something broke, not just patching it
  • Verbose, clear communication — you explain your thinking, document decisions, and surface risks early
  • Comfort working independently without constant oversight
  • Strong judgment when balancing speed vs. correctness


Experience Level

  • 5+ years professional experience building and maintaining PHP applications
  • Proven track record working in real production systems (not just greenfield demos)


Working Environment

  • Results-focused culture: outcomes matter more than hours
  • Remote-friendly, globally distributed team
  • High trust, low micromanagement
  • Direct access to decision-makers and real influence over technical direction


Why This Role

  • Real systems, real users, real problems
  • Autonomy to improve code and architecture meaningfully
  • Opportunity to be a true owner, not a ticket-taker
  • Competitive compensation with room for growth

title: Full-Stack AI Software Engineer
description:
We are hiring three Full-Stack AI Software Engineers (remote, US-based client) with 4+ years of experience in software and AI agent development.

The team is small, fast-moving, and highly hands-on. Engineers will design, build, deploy, monitor, and support an AI-driven platform. You will work across the stack, from backend services to AI agent tuning to infrastructure automation. Candidates must be comfortable owning features end‑to‑end, working independently, and collaborating with distributed teams.

Our client develops AI agents that automate lead follow-up and customer inquiries, allowing in‑person staff to focus on high‑value interactions. The platform will be white-labeled, so engineers must build scalable, configurable, API‑driven solutions with strong attention to performance, reliability, and edge‑case handling.


Responsibilities:


Senior Software Engineers

In addition to the Core responsibilities below:

  • Lead by example—mentor and guide less experienced engineers
  • Provide architectural direction and ensure technical excellence
  • Drive core business initiatives and scalable AI agent development


Mid‑Level Software Engineers

In addition to the Core responsibilities below:

  • Work independently and unblock yourself using AI and other resources
  • Seek guidance when needed—propose solution options, not just problems


Core Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and deliver AI agents and related platform features
  • Integrate platform services with CRMs and third‑party APIs
  • Use AI tools, frameworks, and LLMs to enhance workflows, automate tasks, and optimize customer interactions
  • Build and maintain /Django backend services and scalable REST APIs
  • Conduct hands‑on coding, code reviews, and contribute to system architecture
  • Implement automated QA checks, assist with manual QA when needed, and build scripts/tools to improve testing coverage and reliability
  • Participate in real‑time monitoring and automated load balancing of AI agent infrastructure
  • Diagnose and resolve defects—identify root causes and implement long‑term fixes
  • Communicate technical concepts clearly to technical and non‑technical stakeholders


Required Experience (Must-Have)

  • Excellent written and verbal English communication
  • Minimum 4+ years of Software Engineering Experience
  • Frontend experience should include one of: , Redux, Mui, -query, -table, or Husky
  • Backend experience should include: Python, Django, Postgres, Celery, RabbitMQ
  • CI/CD and infrastructure experience should include: AWS, Terraform, Kubernetes, and Gitlab
  • Experienced in performing comprehensive unit testing, collaborating with QA to ensure the team achieves coverage goals, and assisting with automated test development as needed
  • Deep understanding of LLMs, RAG pipelines, model selection, and AI optimization
  • Strong experience building and maintaining REST APIs with robust edge‑case handling and diagnostic logging
  • Proven skill integrating systems via APIs (CRMs strongly preferred)
  • Successful track record in high‑growth lean startup environments
  • Ability to make independent decisions in fast‑changing contexts
  • Experience working in fully remote distributed engineering teams
  • Familiarity with Agile project management and defect tracking tools
  • Strong troubleshooting and problem‑solving abilities


Preferred Experience (desired but not required)

  • Technical or engineering degree (or equivalent experience)
  • Experience with white‑label architectures
  • Exposure to AI agent orchestration tools or workflow engines
  • Experience with test automation frameworks


Additional Information

  • Enjoy a fun, fast-growing entrepreneurial company, and work with innovative and creative people
  • Be part of a highly collaborative learning culture - share knowledge, be inclusive, learn and grow together. Embrace teamwork!
  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter - think big!
  • Making mistakes is human - let's learn from them - be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual - no presumptions or judgment
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), one floating day, three sick days, and your national holidays


About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent who enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We focus on providing world-class remote resources who work as valued members of client teams. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Manager - Accounting Advisory & Financial Reporting (Capital Markets)
description:
About the Role

We are seeking a Manager in Accounting Advisory & Financial Reporting to join our growing team. This role is ideal for an experienced accounting professional with expertise in IFRS, US GAAP, and technical accounting matters, particularly in advising businesses through reporting and compliance challenges.


The ideal candidate will have experience in Big Four accounting firms, audit, and accounting advisory services , as well as exposure to multiple industries such as manufacturing, infrastructure, SaaS, retail, and professional services. This role offers an excellent opportunity to gain high-level advisory experience while working with senior leadership and supporting clients through complex accounting matters.


Key Responsibilities

  • Provide technical accounting advisory services , including IFRS and US GAAP conversions, financial statement preparation, and complex transaction analysis.
  • Assist in advisory engagements related to financial reporting, internal controls, and accounting policy implementations.
  • Support CFOs, Controllers, and Finance teams with regulatory compliance, GAAP conversions, and implementation of new accounting standards.
  • Conduct research on technical accounting issues and provide recommendations for best practices.
  • Assist in M&A transactions by supporting purchase accounting, due diligence, and post-merger financial reporting.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to improve financial reporting and accounting processes.
  • Mentor and guide junior professionals, ensuring quality service delivery and knowledge sharing.


Qualifications & Experience

  • 7+ years of experience in accounting advisory, financial reporting, or external audit.
  • Big Four or global advisory firm experience is preferred.
  • Strong knowledge of IFRS, US GAAP, and other international accounting frameworks .
  • CPA, Chartered Accountant, or equivalent certification is required (or in progress).
  • Exposure to multiple industries (e.g., SaaS, manufacturing, retail, infrastructure) is a plus.
  • Strong problem-solving and analytical skills, with the ability to manage multiple projects.
  • Excellent communication and client management skills.
  • Bilingual proficiency in Portuguese, Spanish, or English is a plus.

title: Pessoa Desenvolvedora Backend Sênior - Node.js
description:
Descrição da vaga

Estamos em busca de um(a) Desenvolvedor(a) Backend Sênior – Node.js (PIX) para atuar em projetos de alta complexidade e criticidade, dentro de um ambiente financeiro robusto, dinâmico e orientado à excelência técnica.


Você fará parte de um time altamente qualificado, responsável por desenvolver, evoluir e sustentar sistemas críticos de meios de pagamento , com forte foco em performance, segurança, escalabilidade e qualidade das entregas . Esse profissional atuará como referência técnica , contribuindo ativamente para decisões arquiteturais, definição de boas práticas e mentoria do time.


Nosso ambiente de trabalho é colaborativo, ágil e orientado a resultados, com interação constante entre Backend, Frontend, QA, UI/UX, Analistas de Sistemas e PO de negócio. Valorizamos autonomia, responsabilidade técnica e melhoria contínua.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Principais atividades:


  • Atuar no desenvolvimento e implantação de sistemas backend utilizando Node.js , seguindo boas práticas e padrões arquiteturais.
  • Desenvolver APIs RESTful robustas, seguras e escaláveis, com foco em PIX e sistemas financeiros .
  • Trabalhar com arquitetura de microserviços , containers (Docker ) e esteiras automatizadas de CI/CD .
  • Realizar análises técnicas de demandas negociais e evolutivas, em conjunto com analistas de sistemas e times de negócio.
  • Garantir a qualidade técnica , performance e segurança dos sistemas em produção e homologação.
  • Criar e manter documentação técnica e arquitetural dos sistemas.
  • Atuar na mentoria técnica da equipe , apoiando boas práticas de desenvolvimento, testes e arquitetura.
  • Contribuir para a evolução contínua da arquitetura e dos padrões técnicos adotados no CCS (MDS).

Requisitos e qualificações

Formação:


  • Formação superior completa em áreas de tecnologia


Competências esperadas:


  • Node.js com Express (ES6 ou superior).
  • Arquitetura de software , princípios RESTful e padrões de projeto.
  • MongoDB (incluindo consultas complexas com aggregate) e bancos relacionais (SQL).
  • Mensageria (Kafka, RabbitMQ, IBM MQ ou similares).
  • Testes unitários e de integração , qualidade de código e ferramentas como Sonar.
  • Versionamento com Git e GitFlow .
  • CI/CD (Jenkins, Sonar, pipelines automatizados).
  • Programação orientada a objetos, funcional e reativa .
  • Clean Code e Refactoring .
  • Experiência com PIX , setor financeiro ou meios de pagamento.

Diferencial para a vaga:


  • Experiência em sistemas financeiros, bancários ou de alto volume transacional
  • Conhecimento em segurança da informação e LGPD .

Informações adicionais

CONHEÇA NOSSOS BENEFÍCIOS


Alguns dos nossos benefícios são flexíveis para que você possa distribuí-los de acordo com suas necessidades, interesses e momento de vida. São eles:


  • All Points (Programa de pontos para passagens áreas e hospedagens);
  • Assistência Médica;
  • Assistência Odontológica;
  • Seguro de vida;
  • Convênio para Pet;
  • Mobilidade (incluindo opção de combustível e Uber, 99);
  • Reembolso Flex (óculos, vacinas, educação, shows e outros);
  • Vale Refeição e/ou Vale Alimentação.

Outros benefícios:


  • Birthday off;
  • Gympass;
  • Consultoria financeira e empréstimo facilitado;
  • Clube Alelo com diversos descontos em lojas e farmácias;
  • Licença Maternidade de 180 dias;
  • Licença Paternidade de 30 dias;
  • Auxílio creche no primeiro ano do bebê;
  • Vale Transporte conforme a demanda do projeto ou área;
  • Comissionamento por indicação de novos clientes.

title: Mobile Software Engineer – React Native (Mid/Senior)
description:
eNor Securities is a fintech focused on financial infrastructure, digital assets, and regulated products , operating at the intersection of traditional finance and the crypto ecosystem.

We work in a highly complex technical and regulatory environment , building products that require robustness, security, scalability, and clear architecture .

Our engineering team works closely with product and business, making technical decisions with real impact on operations and company growth.

About the role

We are looking for a Mobile Software Engineer with a strong focus on React Native to strategically contribute to the evolution of our mobile applications.

Beyond building screens, we seek someone with strong engineering fundamentals , mobile architectural thinking , and the ability to collaborate closely with backend, product, and design.

You will help build scalable, stable, and high-quality mobile applications , designed to support critical financial products and long-term evolution.


Expected profile
  • Mid to Senior level
  • 5+ years of experience in mobile or frontend development
  • Strong understanding of mobile architecture and state management
  • Comfortable discussing technical trade-offs and proposing solutions
  • Hands-on , collaborative, quality-oriented mindset
  • Technical English required for reading, writing, and professional communication


Required skills
  • Solid experience with React Native
  • Strong proficiency in JavaScript and TypeScript
  • Experience with modern mobile architectures and component-based design
  • Familiarity with REST and/or GraphQL APIs
  • Ability to write testable, performant, and maintainable mobile code
  • Understanding of the mobile lifecycle (Android and iOS)


Nice to have
  • State management (Redux, Zustand, MobX, or similar)
  • Modern React / React Native patterns (Hooks, Context, performance optimizations)
  • Mobile testing (Jest, React Native Testing Library, Detox, or similar)
  • App publishing and maintenance on App Store and Google Play
  • Native API integrations (native modules, bridges)
  • Mobile CI/CD
  • Familiarity with Expo (and clarity on when to use or not)


Responsibilities
  • Contribute to the architectural evolution of mobile applications
  • Implement features aligned with product and design
  • Propose improvements in performance, stability, and user experience
  • Ensure scalable, testable, and sustainable mobile code
  • Work closely with backend, product, and design teams
  • Support continuous improvement of mobile practices and standards


Differentials
  • Experience in fintech, crypto, or financial products
  • Background in large-scale or complex mobile applications
  • Knowledge of mobile performance, UX, and security best practices
  • Senior engineer mindset with a systemic and product-oriented view


If you enjoy real technical challenges and want to build impactful financial infrastructure, come join eNor Securities.
